units: <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Eruvin 7:1:4">Y. Erub. VII, beg. 24ᵇ</cite> <he>ה׳ תשעים וכ׳</he> a circumference of ninety &c.
<cite ref="Shabbat 20a:7">Sabb. 20ᵃ</cite> <he>רוב הֶיקֵּפוֹ</he> the larger portion of the surface of the wood (burning), opp. <he>רוב עביו</he>.
<cite ref="Sukkah 7b:19">Succ. 7ᵇ</cite> <he>אם יש בהֶקֵּיפָהּ וכ׳</he> if there is room enough in the circumference of a round Succah to seat &c.
<cite ref="Mishnah Eruvin 1:5">Erub. I, 5</cite>, a. e. <he>כל שיש בהיקפו וכ׳</he> whatever (circle) has a circumference of three hand-breadths, has a width (diameter) of one.
<cite ref="Bava Batra 13b:12">B. Bath. 13ᵇ</cite> <he>כדי לגול ה׳</he> enough (blank parchment) to be wrapt around the entire rolled-up scroll.
<cite ref="Bava Batra 14a:2">Ib. 14ᵃ</cite> <he>קשיא הקף</he> this is in contradiction to what has been said above ‘enough to be wrapt &c.’; a. fr.
<cite ref="Tosefta Bava Metzia 8:27">Tosef. B. Mets. VIII, 27</cite> <he>כדי שיגבה הקיפו</he> sufficient time to collect his outstandings (to wind up his business).
